extracted.name: California Farm Mini Pancakes
extracted.description: There is a special pan in Northern Europe to make mini pancakes. It makes 14 at a time. Tradition is that children sing a song that counts the pancakes as they get the pancakes served. If you do not have this pancake pan, you can make mini pancakes in a regular cast iron skillet with thicker mini pancake batter. Both recipes are in here. The mini pancakes are called Puffs in local languages, sprinkled with powdered sugar and cinnamon mix. The puff comes from the baking powder in the batter, it makes for lighter pancakes. #pancakeday
ingredient_lines: 2 cups or 1 cup warm full milk
instruction_lines: Whisk a test batch of thin batter with dry ingredients, then eggs, butter, honey, then two cups of milk. Rest the batter. Heat the pan. Bake one mini pancake golden on one side in one minute in a low heat pan in molten butter. Add more sugar plus honey to the batter if the pancake is not golden in one minute.
Bake 14 mini pancakes brown in one minute on a drop of molten butter, then flip and bake one to two minutes till puffed up and done on the other side
If you use a regular skillet, whisk a test batch of thick batter made with the quantities of dry ingredients listed here, then eggs, butter, sugar, honey, then one cup of milk instead of two.
Bake one teaspoon of batter two minutes, flip with two bamboo skewers, bake other side two minutes.
Sprinkle with the cinnamon powder. Top with powdered sugar. Serve or freeze. Enjoy.
